text:
The dish is an arugula salad with a few asparagus spears and a little radicchio, on a square plate of roughly 26 cm. The greens cover about 15 x 20 cm, which is a fairly loose pile. I estimate about 60 g of arugula and 3 asparagus spears at roughly 40 g, which gives about 100 g in total. There appears to be a light dressing, and possibly some cheese shavings at the top. Arugula is very low in energy, about 25 kcal per 100 g, and asparagus is about 20 kcal per 100 g. Adding about 1 tbsp of oil dressing (around 80 kcal) and a little cheese brings the total to roughly 110 kcal.
